rule.name: unique_nearest_real_nba_player_rebound_exact_name_within_3s_and_unassigned
requirements: NBA event is a real rebound
NBA PLAYER1_ID is a player ID, not a team ID
normalized NBA rebound description begins with the exact PBP rebound name key
NBA event is within 3 seconds of the PBP rebound interval
nearest qualifying NBA event is unique
candidate NBA event is not already assigned by the production baseline

rejected_candidates.integrity_gate: one NBA rebound event may not be assigned to two PBP rebound rows

note: Sabonis 22201076/529 satisfied the proximity/name rule but was independently promoted and fully regressed in V12. Johnson is explicitly rejected because the otherwise matching NBA event is already consumed by PBP row 7324.
